professionalSummary: Refit project manager at a high‑street bank from 2022 to 2025, leading four cohorts of twelve branches each from survey to reopening on schedules agreed with the property team and the fit‑out contractor. (src_0d574b46f683)
experienceHighlights: Tracked every branch's cost against the cohort budget in the programme cost tool and reported fortnightly to the refit steering group; the forty‑eight branches closed within budget at cohort level. (src_0428191bcacd)

Resolved clashes between the fit‑out and the branches' IT and cash‑handling changes through the programme's clash log, with the IT and cash‑handling teams' sign‑off recorded against each clash. (src_ab47ef4c5fd7)

Prepared the reopening readiness pack for each branch; the reopening decision was the regional director's, recorded on the pack together with the checks that were mine and the checks that were branch operations. (src_934c6a7d9bf6)
Closed each branch refit with the snagging list agreed with the contractor and the reopening certificate countersigned by the branch manager. (src_f3bac4d099c0)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one cohort schedule, the cost tool extract for one cohort, one reopening readiness pack with the regional director's decision, and one snagging list with its reopening certificate, with the programme cost tool references as a verification trail. (src_ae0b8dc4be74)
